response.sql: WITH filtered AS (SELECT m.Name AS MediaTypeName, t.UnitPrice, 1.0 * t.Bytes / NULLIF(t.Milliseconds, 0) AS BytesPerMs FROM Track t JOIN MediaType m ON m.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId WHERE t.Bytes >= 10323804), per_type AS (SELECT MediaTypeName, AVG(UnitPrice) AS avg_unit_price, AVG(BytesPerMs) AS avg_bytes_per_ms FROM filtered GROUP BY MediaTypeName), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_bytes_per_ms) AS across_avg FROM per_type) SELECT p.MediaTypeName, p.avg_unit_price, p.avg_bytes_per_ms, p.avg_bytes_per_ms / o.across_avg AS ratio_to_across_avg FROM per_type p CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE o.across_avg IS NOT NULL;

assumptions.assumption: Media types are grouped by Name with an inner join to Track; the per-track ratio uses real division (1.0 * Bytes / Milliseconds); each type's ratio figure is the mean of its per-track ratios; the across-type average is the unweighted mean of those per-type means.
Tracks with Milliseconds = 0 are treated as missing for the ratio (NULLIF), since the request does not say how to handle zero length.

alternatives.interpretation: The across-media-type average is track-weighted: the mean of the per-track Bytes/Milliseconds ratio over all qualifying tracks, rather than the unweighted mean of the per-type averages.
